assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for metformin safety; obtain serum creatinine/eGFR before initiating metformin.
Full lipid profile (LDL, TG, non‑HDL‑C) missing – assume dyslipidaemia based on low HDL; order fasting lipid panel.
HbA1c and fasting glucose not available – assume high risk of pre‑diabetes; obtain labs to confirm before metformin/semaglutide.
BMI and waist circumference not recorded – assume BMI ≥30 kg/m² (obesity) per problem list; obtain exact measurements.
QRISK score not calculated – assume ≥10% given metabolic syndrome; calculate once labs and age are known.
Liver function tests not available – obtain ALT/AST before starting atorvastatin.
No documented allergy to ACE‑I, statin, or GLP‑1 RA – verify at next visit.
treatment_summary: The plan adds amlodipine to the existing lisinopril to achieve BP target, initiates atorvastatin for cardiovascular risk reduction, starts metformin MR for diabetes prevention (pending eGFR), and introduces semaglutide for weight loss (pending BMI and contraindication review). Monitoring includes BP checks, renal and liver function, lipid panel, HbA1c, and weight. Lifestyle interventions and CPAP referral for OSA are recommended alongside pharmacotherapy.
